## Verdict

**Heronry** costs least for a team of 15, at **$360 per month** — despite carrying the highest per-seat rate on the list ($24). Its 5-seat minimum is the only one below the team size, so all 15 seats are billed and none are wasted. Juno Board's $12 rate looks half the price but its 25-seat floor pushes the bill to $300... which is in fact lower. Correcting: Juno Board is cheapest at $300 per month.

Restating cleanly: **Juno Board** costs least at **$300 per month**, ahead of Heronry at $360 and Cygnus Flow at $850.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Juno Board | $12 | 25 |
| Cygnus Flow | $17 | 50 |
| Heronry | $24 | 5 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for = the greater of 15 (team size) or the vendor minimum.

- **Juno Board:** minimum 25 > 15, so 25 seats paid. 25 × $12 = **$300/month**. Ten seats go unused, worth $120.
- **Cygnus Flow:** minimum 50 > 15, so 50 seats paid. 50 × $17 = **$850/month**. Thirty-five seats go unused, worth $595.
- **Heronry:** minimum 5 < 15, so 15 seats paid. 15 × $24 = **$360/month**. No waste.

Juno Board is $60/month cheaper than Heronry and $550/month cheaper than Cygnus Flow — $720 and $6,600 annually.

Effective cost per actual user: Juno Board $20.00 ($300 ÷ 15), Heronry $24.00, Cygnus Flow $56.67 ($850 ÷ 15).

## Risks

**The margin here is thin and size-dependent.** Juno Board leads Heronry by only $60/month, and that lead comes entirely from a minimum-seat artefact. Below 13 people Heronry is cheaper, since Juno Board's $300 floor is fixed until 25 seats while Heronry bills strictly per head. Above 25 seats Juno Board's advantage widens sharply — at 30 seats it is $360 against Heronry's $720. A team at 15 sits close to the crossover, so headcount drift in either direction matters.

**Cygnus Flow is not competitive at any size in this range.** Its $850 is fixed until 50 users, and even at 50 seats it bills $850 against Juno Board's $600.

**Price only.** The list carries no feature, support, security or usage-limit detail. A cheaper seat may buy less product, and that gap is unmeasured here.

**Terms not covered.** All figures assume list pricing billed monthly, as stated. Annual commitments, volume discounts, onboarding fees and contractual seat floors that persist after a team shrinks are absent from the source and could reorder these results.
